title: R11 diagnostic probe: paired, same-job resolution of the standalone-508 vs pool-318 s/tile run-phase anomaly; this protocol accepts NO product change
frozen_before_timing: 2026-10-16, commit 94cd7b50 (X01 post-E2E review fix); no run-phase probe timing has happened under this protocol

change_under_test.summary: diagnostic-only probe on the accepted X02+X01 state; product source is frozen at the accepted diff

measured_facts: p2_clean (phase0): ONE tile 0_0 through execute_tiles, workers=1, threads_per_worker=8 (child env NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=8/OMP=8), clean (no profiler): wall 508.2 s; TMRT bitwise vs p2_ref

p2_profile (phase0): same dispatch under parent-side cProfile: wall 551.4 s; cProfile saw only time.sleep in execute_tiles — the engine runs in a runtime_worker subprocess, so child-side numbers come from p2c_child

p2c_child (phase1c): cProfile INSIDE the runtime_worker child: wall 548.8 s under 93.7M profiled calls; engine seam 24 calls total 521.4 s; night steps ~6.06 s vs day steps ~31-36 s (bimodal 5.2x); hot: Lcyl region_pool 185.1 s cum, run_prepared_gvf_step 149.2 s tottime, Kside aniso 115.5 s cum (decode_block 52.5 tottime, classify_block_aosoa 43.6 cum), lw_primary_b 76.5 s tottime
X01 E2E (phase1b, job 14096139): run phase 2545.9 s for 24 tiles at 3 workers x 8 threads => ~318 s/tile effective; no per-child run-phase seams were recorded

pool children are ~1.6x FASTER per tile than the standalone run despite identical declared child env; product code sets NO affinity pinning (only runtime.py reads sched_getaffinity; no sched_setaffinity, no taskset)
hypotheses: H1 machine-state: the 508 s standalone leg ran under different machine conditions (page-cache/frequency/noisy neighbor); ~318 s is the true steady state
H2 tile-mix: tile 0_0 is heavier than the average E2E tile; per-tile spread explains part of the gap
H3 placement: 3 concurrent children interact favorably with the machine (NUMA interleaving, OMP spin-wait behavior) in a way a lone 8-thread process does not
H4 measurement artifact: an arithmetic or accounting error (imbalance/straggler hiding in 2545.9/8, or hidden warmup in p2_clean)
motivation.why_it_matters: R11 candidate sizing needs the RIGHT baseline: if ~318 s/tile is the true pool-child steady state, the cProfile-inflated p2c shares are the only profile available and clean per-child seams are needed; if 508 s is the true single-tile floor, a ~1.6x per-tile opportunity exists in placement/scheduling

probe_design.one_job_same_node: all arms in ONE sbatch allocation, order A,B,A2,B2,D to separate machine drift from treatment
probe_design.scene: 3-tile subset (0_0, 1_0, 0_1) of the frozen S10 synthetic corpus at /tmp/s11_r11_probe, built cold by the driver; untimed walls+aspect+SVF prep for exactly those tiles before any timed arm; manifest sha256 of the subset recorded in the driver and asserted
probe_design.prime: untimed 64^2 prime first (shared NUMBA_CACHE_DIR), phase0/1 pattern

arms.A_standalone_1x8: workers=1, threads_per_worker=8; execute_tiles on tile 0_0; wall around the call; TMRT_0_0 bitwise vs p2_ref_TMRT.tif
arms.B_pool_3x8: workers=3, threads_per_worker=8; execute_tiles on [0_0, 1_0, 0_1]; wall around the call; per-child seam dumps (engine/utci/write/checkpoint totals + engine per-call list + child startup wall + sched_getaffinity size) via the seam-only sitecustomize hook (S11_CHILD_SEAM=1, per-pid JSON at child exit); TMRT_0_0 bitwise
arms.D_standalone_1x24: workers=1, threads_per_worker=24; diagnostic ceiling only, NOT a product config; wall; TMRT_0_0 bitwise

recorded_per_arm: numactl topology + lscpu summary (once per job)
asserts_before_timing: git merge-base --is-ancestor of the frozen commit at job start
product diff file list + sha256 equal to change_under_test
subset-scene manifest sha256 equal to the driver constant
probe_design.bitwise_criteria: every timed arm's TMRT_0_0.tif all bands equal vs p2_ref_TMRT.tif; any diff aborts the probe (environment broken, no conclusions drawn)
probe_design.timing_rules: no retries except a documented infrastructure anomaly (crash, node eviction, admission refusal), never an undesired number; no product files change while the job runs

acceptance.probe_is_diagnostic_only: the probe accepts NO product change; its output is a causal resolution naming the supported hypothesis (or a recorded refutation of all four) plus clean per-child engine numbers for R11 candidate sizing
acceptance.follow_on: any R11 candidate (scheduling/overlap only; frozen C5/C6/N8/N9 arithmetic untouched; no timestep parallelism) requires its own frozen protocol, independent review, E2E bitwise A/B, and REGISTER row

environment.numba: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR shared with phases 0/1; threading_layer omp
environment.origin: repo .venv editable install of branch src; job echoes git rev-parse HEAD + product diff file list
